findings.en_sentence: A well-preserved skull allowed Othniel Charles Marsh to create a brain mold in 1880, which showed Stegosaurus had a very small brain, possibly the smallest among dinosaurs.
findings.es_sentence: Un cráneo bien conservado permitió a Othniel Charles Marsh crear un molde cerebral en 1880, que demostró que Stegosaurus tenía un cerebro muy pequeño, posiblemente el más pequeño entre los dinosaurios.
findings.problem: Reads as the smallest brain in absolute terms; the record is relative to body size (proportionally smallest of the dinosaur endocasts known then). Many small dinosaurs had smaller brains in absolute terms.
findings.correct: ...a very small brain, proportionally the smallest of any dinosaur endocast known at the time. / ...un cerebro muy pequeño, el menor en proporción al cuerpo de todos los moldes de dinosaurio conocidos entonces.

findings.en_sentence: A large shoulder spike preserved in Stegosaurus sulcatus is speculated to be a key diagnostic feature for that species.
findings.problem: The speculation is about whether the spike sat on the shoulder. Its use to diagnose the species is not in doubt, but the sentence moves the speculation onto that.
findings.correct: Stegosaurus sulcatus preserves a large spike, possibly from the shoulder, that is used to diagnose the species.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Bone Wars and Stegosaurus armatus; F019 quote

findings.es_sentence: Una gran espina del hombro conservada en Stegosaurus sulcatus se especula que es una característica diagnóstica clave para esa especie.
findings.problem: The construction is ungrammatical, copied from the English passive ('X se especula que es'), and it repeats the misreading in the English.
findings.correct: Stegosaurus sulcatus conserva una gran espina, quizá del hombro, que se utiliza para diagnosticar la especie.

findings.en_sentence: The sacro-lumbar expansion found in Stegosaurus is a structure also present in birds and other ornithischians, and in birds, this expansion contains a glycogen body, a structure postulated to supply glycogen to the nervous system.
findings.es_sentence: La expansión sacrolumbar encontrada en Stegosaurus es una estructura también presente en aves y otros ornitisquios, y en las aves, esta expansión contiene un cuerpo de glucógeno, una estructura postulada para suministrar glucógeno al sistema nervioso.
findings.problem: 'birds and other ornithischians' presents birds as ornithischians, which they are not (birds are theropods, i.e. saurischians). The source says the expansion is found beyond ornithischians, in birds as well.
findings.correct: ...a structure not unique to stegosaurs or even to ornithischians: it is also present in birds, where... / ...una estructura que no es exclusiva de los estegosaurios ni de los ornitisquios: también aparece en las aves, donde...
findings.checked_in: F143 quote; enwiki Brain/sacral expansion section; knowledge

findings.es_sentence: La hipótesis de que Stegosaurus podía erguirse sobre sus patas traseras fue propuesta por Bakker y opuesta por Carpenter, mientras que un estudio de 2010 de Mallison encontró apoyo para una postura erguida en el kentrosauro pero no para la capacidad de su cola para actuar como trípode.
findings.problem: The genus name is translated as 'el kentrosauro'; the rest of the page uses Latin genus names in italics. 'opuesta por Carpenter' is a calque of 'opposed by'.
findings.correct: ...fue propuesta por Bakker y rebatida por Carpenter, mientras que un estudio de Mallison (2010) respaldó una postura erguida en Kentrosaurus, aunque no que la cola pudiera servir de trípode.

findings.en_sentence: The hypothesis that Stegosaurus could rear up on its hind legs was proposed by Bakker and opposed by Carpenter, while a 2010 study by Mallison found support for a rearing posture in Kentrosaurus but not for the ability of its tail to act as a tripod.
findings.es_sentence: La hipótesis de que Stegosaurus podía erguirse sobre sus patas traseras fue propuesta por Bakker y opuesta por Carpenter, mientras que un estudio de 2010 de Mallison encontró apoyo para una postura erguida en el kentrosauro pero no para la capacidad de su cola para actuar como trípode.
findings.problem: Kentrosaurus appears with no introduction as a related stegosaur, so the reader cannot see why a Kentrosaurus study matters here. In English, 'its tail' could mean either genus.
findings.correct: ...a 2010 study by Mallison on the related stegosaur Kentrosaurus found support for rearing, but not for the tail acting as a tripod.

findings.en_sentence: Four different arrangements for the plates on Stegosaurus have been proposed over the years, and Frederick Lucas later changed his view to believe that Stegosaurus plates were attached in staggered rows.
findings.es_sentence: Se han propuesto cuatro arreglos diferentes para las placas de Stegosaurus a lo largo de los años, y Frederick Lucas cambió posteriormente su opinión para creer que las placas de Stegosaurus estaban unidas en filas escalonadas.
findings.problem: Lucas is never introduced, and the sentence never says what his earlier view was (paired plates in two rows, 1901), so 'changed his view' has nothing to refer to. His name is Frederic A. Lucas; 'Frederick' is a spelling error carried over from enwiki.
findings.correct: In 1901 Frederic A. Lucas proposed paired plates in two rows, but a year later he concluded they were probably arranged in staggered rows.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Early skeletal mounts and plate interpretation (F045); knowledge (Frederic Augustus Lucas)

findings.es_sentence: Se han propuesto cuatro arreglos diferentes para las placas de Stegosaurus a lo largo de los años, y Frederick Lucas cambió posteriormente su opinión para creer que las placas de Stegosaurus estaban unidas en filas escalonadas.
findings.problem: 'arreglos' is a calque of 'arrangements', and 'cambió su opinión para creer que' is a calque of 'changed his view to believe'.
findings.correct: Con los años se han propuesto cuatro disposiciones distintas de las placas; Frederic Lucas acabó concluyendo que estaban dispuestas en filas alternas.

findings.en_sentence: Stegosaurus lived alongside Apatosaurus, Diplodocus, Camarasaurus, and Allosaurus, which may have preyed on it.
findings.problem: 'which may have preyed on it' can be read as covering all four genera, sauropods included. The source says only Allosaurus ('the latter'). The Spanish singular 'pudo' avoids this.
findings.correct: ...and Allosaurus, the last of which may have preyed on it.
